scope: Read-only LOCAL static review for one existing-CPU, bounded physical-clone PG-only recovery/SQL probe. No SSH/cloud/start/SQL/action performed by reviewer.
decision: No blocking defect found for the single bounded probe with exact actual main-postmaster identity enforcement and externally owned 75-second JVM timeout; no controller/inspector edits authorized or made.

sourceEntries.fact: Startup saves/copies argv for later process-display use; this call does not itself require original Linux argv bytes to be overwritten.

Linux selects CLOBBER_ARGV, but init_ps_display returns when !IsUnderPostmaster. Child initialization forces its first title update, even if update_process_title was off; that is not a main-postmaster title update.
InitPostmasterChild changes IsUnderPostmaster to true for subprocesses.
No init_ps_display call found in this entire fixed postmaster.c; all backend C callers are enumerated separately.
Libc actual version is intentionally NULL for C, C.* and POSIX locales; otherwise glibc version is used on Linux.
pg_database_collation_actual_version selects provider locale and can return NULL; NULL does not itself prove all locale/library compatibility.

pg_is_in_recovery is an available boolean function; pg_control_system exposes control/catalog/system identifier. The frozen inspector currently checks control identity but does not query pg_is_in_recovery.

primarySource.binaryInferenceLimit: This is exact official 18.6 primary source, not proof that the separate Zonky binary is byte-identical to an unpatched official build. Actual original binary SHA/version and live main PID argv must remain independently observed.

checks.mainPostmasterExpectedArgvStable: Supported by false default IsUnderPostmaster + child-only transition/init callers. Never follow child process titles or identify owned main PG from a postgres: prefix.
checks.lifecycle: Fixed original PGDATA/binary/port; fresh no-PID/no-reissue guard; numeric UID963/GID963/no extra groups; actual argv/startTicks/SHA checked; pidfd directed SIGINT; mismatches explicitly fail without pretending stopped.
checks.sqlReadOnly: Fixed localhost DB/role, pgjdbc readOnly always + server default/read-only repeatable-read verified, only SELECT plus JDBC session transaction configuration and rollback, no PostgresEventStore schema initialization or projector.
checks.ledger: Same-source typed Event + alphabetically sorted Jackson reencoding checks stored payload SHA, JSONB semantic equality, indexed columns, event sequence from1, positive market sequence from1, counts/trades/cursor maxima. JSONB text SHA is not substituted for original payload SHA.
checks.sourceReconciliation: PG ledger internal consistency only. Source canonical/outbox/exportedSeq comparison remains mandatory later.
checks.wal: Start pins fsync/synchronous_commit/full_page_writes on; inspector reads back fsync/synchronous_commit and physical control system identity. It does not run WAL replay verification, page-checksum scan, pg_is_in_recovery or full_page_writes SQL readback; do not claim those were tested.
checks.locale: Captures database provider/collation/ctype/locale stored+actual version, conservatively fails on any stored installed collation mismatch. Stored NULL version currently passes version guard; record NULL distinctly and do not call that full locale compatibility proof.

requiredOperationalLimits: Root external owned JVM timeout75 seconds; no Java hard60-second total-lifetime claim. Frozen Java60-second check occurs only while iterating events; metadata/empty-ledger paths do not enforce it.
PG observation deadline180 seconds from launch plus up to30 seconds clean-stop wait; no hard lifetime promise against controller SIGKILL/OOM/kernel-stuck shutdown.

Root must keep exact actual main-postmaster PID/startTicks/argv-SHA observation. If it differs, preserve cleanup-unconfirmed as failure; do not relax into numeric PID signalling or claim stop success. A future revision may retain the already-open stable main pidfd for exceptional cleanup.
Installed but unused collation mismatch is a conservative stop, not automatic proof a trading index is corrupt; never refresh version solely to remove warnings.

Post-start clone can have legitimate internal PG WAL/control/stat/hint-bit/postmaster.opts writes. Do not rerun full original-backup byte-equality preflight after startup. Capture new inventory/diff and independently read clean pg_controldata + same systemID, hashing critical files before/after that read-only tool.
One attempt only; preserve partial logs/raw proof, exact source and frozen pre-start inventory, original backups. No autoinit/retry/reset/cursor change.
minimalFutureRevisionIdeasNotImplemented: Add actual pg_is_in_recovery=false and full_page_writes readback if those claims are desired.
Add final elapsed<60 seconds success gate if a60-second acceptance deadline is desired; keep separate external process timeout.
Use already-held main pidfd for explicitly scoped exceptional cleanup while preserving changed actual argv as failed attestation.
